title: ABC24 – 24th Asian Bioethics Conference Website
shortDesc: A global digital hub for conference details, participant registration, speaker scheduling, and abstract paper submissions.
overview: The 24th Asian Bioethics Conference (ABC24) brought together over 1,200 delegates, researchers, and bioethicists from across 35 countries. Brain Bari engineered the official conference portal, streamlining delegate onboarding, paper submissions, and secure multi-currency payment collection.
keyFeatures: Automated Abstract Submission & Peer Review Engine
Dynamic Real-Time Speaker & Interactive Session Scheduler
Instant Delegate Verification & Digital Badge Generation
challenge: The conference required a unified global platform to handle multi-country participant registrations, abstract paper submissions with peer-review routing, and secure cross-border currency transactions without latency or server failure during peak registration deadlines.
solution: Brain Bari developed a scalable Next.js architecture hosted on high-availability edge networks. We integrated automated PDF processing for research abstracts, dynamic schedule builders, and localized payment reconciliation with real-time currency conversion.
results: Over 1,200 international delegates onboarded with 100% platform uptime throughout the conference proceedings, eliminating manual administrative paperwork completely.

title: TaxBot: Intelligent Tax Consultation and Planning System
shortDesc: An autonomous AI consultant providing real-time, secure, and personalized tax guidance compliant with Bangladesh NBR guidelines.
overview: TaxBot is an autonomous, AI-driven tax intelligence and filing advisory assistant. Built specifically around Bangladesh National Board of Revenue (NBR) regulatory codes, TaxBot cuts hours of manual compliance work down to milliseconds with conversational AI.
keyFeatures: RAG Pipeline Indexing Full NBR Fiscal Acts & Official SRO Circulars
Automated Corporate & Individual Tax Bracket Computation
Instant Audit-Ready Tax Summary PDF Generation
Bank-Grade TLS 1.3 Encryption & Anonymized User Sessions
challenge: Corporate clients frequently struggled with complex, constantly evolving tax slabs, resulting in long consultant backlogs, delayed return filings, and substantial consultation costs for repetitive inquiries.
solution: Engineered an intelligent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant indexing the entire National Board of Revenue tax code. The bot automatically computes corporate liabilities, validates deductions, and outputs filing checklists in seconds.
results: Decreased client consultation wait times from 48 hours to under 2 seconds while maintaining a verified 99.4% tax code accuracy rate, freeing human consultants for complex litigation.

title: CCcalculator — The Smart Crypto Profit & ROI Analyzer
shortDesc: Advanced web calculator syncing live token market prices to predict profit margins, tax liabilities, and future ROI simulations.
overview: CCcalculator is an institutional-grade crypto profit, ROI, and tax liability simulator. It connects directly to live decentralized and centralized exchange feeds, allowing traders and investment funds to model multi-stage trades with real-time slippage and fee deduction.
keyFeatures: Sub-100ms Live WebSockets Ticker Feeds across 1,000+ Pairs
Custom Tax Jurisdiction Capital Gains Calculator
Interactive Chart.js PnL Curve & Portfolio Forecasts
challenge: Crypto traders lacked a unified tool that combined real-time exchange rates with custom entry/exit fees, leverage calculations, and tax deduction forecasting across volatile market conditions.
solution: Designed a high-throughput WebSockets platform streaming live tick data across 1,000+ token pairs, featuring interactive profit/loss charts and customizable tax export spreadsheets.
results: Reached over 50,000 monthly active calculations within 90 days of public deployment, maintaining sub-100ms calculation speeds and zero downtime.
